name: astro
description: This is typescript-language-server with the installed @astrojs/ts-plugin@1.10.10 plugin, not a separate astro executable. LSP initialize.initializationOptions.plugins is an array of {name, location, languages}. The printed plugin location is inferred from the Node installation prefix and is not checked for existence. For a project-local or custom installation, override adapter_config.servers[].initializationOptions.plugins[].location with the actual package directory; it handles languageId astro. A tsconfig project should include .astro and use normal TypeScript compilerOptions, including strict and jsx=preserve. Workspace implicitProjectConfiguration.checkJs affects inferred JS, not the tsconfig project.
